title: Kumta Nga Rwai (Thus I Sing to My Motherland)
cultural_context: Reflective patriotic ballad expressing an elder bard's profound reverence and devotion to the pine-clad hills of the Seven Huts.

khasi: Kumta nga rwai ia ka ri baieit,
Ha ki lum ba phyrnai bad ki them ba jyrngam,
Ka mynsiem ka sngewthuh ia ka jinglong tynrai,
Ba U Blei u la pynneh ha ri Hynniewtrep.
english: Thus I sing unto my beloved land,
Across radiant hills and evergreen vales,
The spirit perceives the primordial essence,
Which God hath established in the land of the Seven Huts.

khasi: Kynmaw ia ka burom ki kpa tymmen,
Wat pynsngewsih ia ka ktien u barim,
Pynneh ia ka akor ha man ki jingtrei,
Haduh ban da kiew ka sngi ba thoh ksiar.
english: Remember the noble honor of our ancient fathers,
Grieve not the sacred speech of olden days,
Uphold refined decorum in every labor,

vocabulary.sngi-thoh-ksiar: golden written dawn / era of enlightenment

lyrics_khasi:
Kumta nga rwai ia ka ri baieit,
Ha ki lum ba phyrnai bad ki them ba jyrngam,
Ka mynsiem ka sngewthuh ia ka jinglong tynrai,
Ba U Blei u la pynneh ha ri Hynniewtrep.
Kynmaw ia ka burom ki kpa tymmen,
Wat pynsngewsih ia ka ktien u barim,
Pynneh ia ka akor ha man ki jingtrei,
Haduh ban da kiew ka sngi ba thoh ksiar.
lyrics_english:
Thus I sing unto my beloved land,
Across radiant hills and evergreen vales,
The spirit perceives the primordial essence,
Which God hath established in the land of the Seven Huts.
Remember the noble honor of our ancient fathers,
Grieve not the sacred speech of olden days,
Uphold refined decorum in every labor,
Until the golden-inscribed dawn arises.
